# Hermes Achievements - Public Snapshot

This site is a privacy-safe visual snapshot of an agent achievement system (Hermes).
It represents a public showcase of agent capabilities and milestones.

## Key Facts
- Total Achievements: 60
- Unlocked Achievements: 56
- Completion Rate: 93.3%
- Highest Tier Reached: Olympian
- Latest Unlock: Vibe Architect
- Captured At: 2026-07-15

## Privacy and Provenance
This showcase publishes only aggregate progress, tier labels, and the latest achievement name.
No private session history, local paths, or identity data are included. The data is statically generated from a sanitized snapshot.
